meta.format: scenarios[]: {id, description, config, accounts, steps[], final_state}. config is the Solidity RoundConfig in raw Monad units (camelCase, decimal strings); the NEAR-relevant subset is used: keeperBounty 0, maxEntropyFee 0, seed fee 0 and reserveFloor 0 in the Solidity run, so no Entropy fee and no bounty ever touch the treasury. steps[]: {i, op, at, caller, case?, args, result, events, state}. op is the Rust method name (create_round, launch_coin, start_round, buy, sell, lock_epoch, resolve_epoch, abort_round, refund_launch, claim_consolation, redeem, claim_seed). at is the block timestamp in seconds the step runs at (the engine must be fed this clock). args use the Rust parameter names; buy and launch_coin carry deposit (raw units attached); deadline is unlimited. resolve_epoch.args.seed is the test seed for the epoch (0x hex, 32 bytes); it appears on the first resolve_epoch call of an epoch only (continuation calls reuse the stored seed) and the SeedReady event is listed in that same step. result is {ok:true, return?} (return is a decimal string: coin id for launch_coin, tokens for buy, mon out for sell, mon paid for claims and redeem) or {ok:false, revert:<Solidity error name, same as the Rust ArenaError name>}; a reverted step leaves the state unchanged and must leave the engine state unchanged. events are the Solidity events of the step in emission order with Rust-shaped args (uint8/16/32/64 as numbers, wider as decimal strings, addresses as account labels, token as "<roundId>:<coinId>"); TreasurySpent, CoinImage and EpochCancelled are dropped and EpochLocked has no entropySeq (the Rust event carries lockHeight instead). state is the full state AFTER the step: now, contract_balance, native balances per account, and for every round: all RoundView and RoundExtra fields and per coin all Coin fields plus token balances per holder (nonzero only; arena holds the seed tokens until claim_seed).
meta.authority: Arena.sol (monad-final) deployed by near-parity/forge/script/GenScenario.s.sol with MockSeedSource, driven step by step; no mocks of the engine
meta.cross_check: every non-reverting tracked buy, sell and launch matches shared/src/curve.ts; every clash pair, clash roll, winner rule, hunt roll and bye coin is recomputed from the seed with an independent keccak256 and pairing implementation; redeem payouts recomputed; contract balance at least all liabilities after every step; scenario-specific assertions (underdog clash, byes, partial resolves, hunt successes, failures and level ups, final phase) hold. The generator fails otherwise
meta.seeds: epoch seeds are keccak256 of ASCII "<scenario tag>:<phase>:<epoch>" except the underdog seed which is the first "s3:underdog:<j>" that satisfies the underdog condition

scenarios.description: Blitz preset, 6 coins, full lobby starts at once, 1 leveling epoch (hunts only) then 3 knockout epochs (6 to 4 to 2 to 1). Launch validation reverts, trades before and between epochs, trades rejected while locked, early lock, settle, redeem (partial and full), consolation claims, seed claims, creation of the next round carrying the treasury.

Five coins, lobby deadline start (minCoins 5 of maxCoins 6), one creator with two coins and a third launch rejected, 1 leveling epoch then knockout 5 to 3 to 2 to 1 with a bye in the first two knockout epochs (odd alive count), settle and claims.

Blitz preset with very unequal pools (coin 0 at 30 vs about 0.1 for most others). The knockout seed is searched so the first clash is won by the coin with the LOWER win probability (win_prob_bps at least 1500 away from 5000 and the roll at least 250 away from the threshold); the generator asserts it from the Solidity event.

Blitz preset with 4 leveling epochs: 24 hunts (successes give 10 xp, failures 0), level ups from hunt xp at 15 and 35 xp, then three knockout epochs where clash wins add 20 xp and can level the winner; hunts also run for knockout survivors and byes.

Six coins, clashesPerEpoch 3. The first knockout epoch is resolved in three calls of max_clashes 1 (the seed is delivered once, with the first call): the epoch stays locked, trades and locks are rejected, max_clashes 0 is rejected, hunts and the fee sweep run only in the last call. Then 3 alive coins (1 clash plus a bye) and the final clash.

Lobby underfilled (3 of 6 coins) past the lobby deadline: start rejected, abort_round succeeds (phase Aborted, launch fees owed recorded), a second abort and a late launch are rejected, each creator refunds seed plus launch fee through refund_launch (wrong creator and double refund rejected), the next round can then be created and a coin launched in it. Round 1 treasury ends at 0 and nothing is carried.
